summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with a parametrized test plus None and plain-string checks. test/test_path.py is unchanged. Under the prepared venv, the new tests and test_path.py pass (40 passed). mypy, black, isort, and flake8 are not installed in that venv and were not run, so type-check and formatting are unverified; I only checked that no new line exceeds 88 columns. Nothing is committed.
